facts.statement: Move-out inspection listed six remedial items at 18 Brindle Row (flooring by fireplace, front-window blind, under-stairs cupboard handle, kitchen blind, toilet seat, front-gate hinge).
Former tenant Tomas Venn vacated on 27 August and returned the keys; he could not provide access.
Landlord Ivo Marlow replied on 07/09 'Yes, I am happy for you to proceed with the remedial works', with no price limit or conditions; no provider or price existed at that time.
Alder & Finch Repairs were instructed on 07/09 for a quotation only, expressly told not to carry out work until Northbridge Lettings reviewed the price and issued written authority.
On 10/09 the provider said he had understood the instruction as one to do the work and had completed it the previous day; the call did not establish access, authorisation, scope or price.
Invoice NBL-019-INV-11 dated 11/09 charges £174.00 for the six items as a single line, with no itemisation, no VAT line and no payment terms.
The case holds no appointment record, visit narrative or completion photographs.
The invoice records supply and installation of a new Venetian blind, where the inspection item was a repair to the existing front-window blind — an unquoted variation.

conflicts.description: Agency instruction was quotation-only with no work before written authority; the provider states he was instructed to carry out the work.
conflicts.resolution: The written instruction (event-008) governs over the provider's recollection in a call (event-013): the works were carried out without authority. Whether the invoice is nonetheless paid is a human decision.

conflicts.description: Landlord's unpriced 'proceed' (07/09) versus the rule that a priced quote is approved before work starts.
conflicts.resolution: event-005 approves the works in principle but not the £174.00 amount; invoice approval remains with the landlord (RTE-LANDLORD) once the figure is verified.

conflicts.description: Internal note of 10/09 refers to awaiting an invoice when none had been requested or received at that point.
conflicts.resolution: Recorded as a data-quality defect in the case notes (ACT-3); it does not change the action.

red_flags.description: Work invoiced with no quotation, no itemisation, no VAT position, no appointment record and no completion evidence; the state of the job rests solely on the provider's own account.
red_flags.action_taken: Evidence and itemised breakdown requested from the provider (ACT-1); invoice withheld from payment and the gaps recorded (ACT-3).

red_flags.description: Unexplained access to a vacant property: tenancy ended 27/08 with keys returned and the agency holding a set, yet the provider attended and worked with no recorded access arrangement; security after the visit is unverified.
red_flags.action_taken: Provider asked how access was obtained, whether the property was left secure and whether keys were returned (ACT-1); flagged in the handover.

red_flags.description: Provider acted outside an express written instruction, creating spend the agency had not authorised.
red_flags.action_taken: Recorded for the landlord and the office (ACT-2, ACT-3); no further work instructed to this provider.
